_doc: Board wiring self-test (INK_SELFTEST_BOARD) on the PQ-BN display profile: as board.budget.json, one check fewer (whether a panel cut part way shows nothing is asked of the EPDiy model only: PQ-BN drives phase by phase).

test.fail.why: a board self-test CHECK failed (see warnings)

test.pass.why: fewer board checks ran than expected

power.off.why: the power-off pulses did not turn the device off

accel.motions.why: the accelerometer never saw the turn

camera.captures.why: the camera never delivered a picture
